source.notes: Consolidated legacy 2020 import pack. Mechanically relevant content from the audited extraction scope is combined with stable IDs; applicable official Tasha errata dated 2021-12-13 is reconciled. Session Zero guidance and puzzles are intentionally outside this compendium extraction scope; art-only transition pages contain no materialized mechanics.

officialErrata.source: D&D Beyond Sage Advice & Errata - Tasha’s Cauldron of Everything

externalDependencies.policy: External IDs are intentionally preserved as references and are not duplicated into this source pack.

deduplication.versionPolicy: Legacy Tasha 2020 and later 2024/2025 rules coexist under distinct stable IDs; same-name records are not merged when payloads differ.

coverage.sessionZeroOmissionReason: Guidance/social-contract/party-origin material was outside the mechanically reusable engine-content scope used by this extraction roadmap.
coverage.puzzleOmissionReason: Puzzles, keyed puzzle solutions, and puzzle-specific traps were excluded by the current compendium policy unless a reusable subsystem had already been materialized elsewhere.

items.name: Customizing Your Origin
items.summary: Regra opcional de nível 1 que permite personalizar aumentos raciais de atributos, idiomas e certas proficiências sem alterar as demais características da raça/sub-raça.

extractionNotes: Personality guidance is retained as metadata inside the umbrella rule because it has no direct mechanical effect.
Official Tasha errata eligibility wording reconciled during TASHA-11.

items.name: Custom Origin: Ability Score Increases
items.summary: Cada aumento de atributo recebido da raça ou sub-raça pode ser redirecionado para outro atributo, preservando seu valor; aumentos distintos não podem ser aplicados ao mesmo atributo e nenhum valor pode passar de 20.

extractionNotes: Official Tasha errata clarifies that this option modifies a race’s Ability Score Increase trait.

items.name: Custom Origin: Languages
items.summary: Cada idioma fornecido pelo traço racial Languages pode ser trocado individualmente por outro idioma permitido pela lista da regra; o DM pode modificar a lista conforme a campanha.

extractionNotes: The source page visually reads “Orc”; text extraction/OCR may render this as “Ore”.
Official Tasha errata clarifies that this option applies when the race has the Languages trait.

items.name: Custom Origin: Proficiency Swaps
items.summary: Proficiências concedidas por raça ou sub-raça podem ser trocadas individualmente conforme a tabela de equivalências entre skill, armor, weapons e tools.

extractionNotes: Official Tasha errata eligibility wording reconciled during TASHA-11.

items.name: Custom Lineage
items.summary: Alternativa legacy à escolha de raça no nível 1: Humanoid Small ou Medium, Speed 30 ft., +2 em um atributo, um feat qualificado, Darkvision 60 ft. ou uma skill, Common e um idioma apropriado aprovado pelo DM.

featChoice.restriction: any feat for which the character qualifies

extractionNotes: Modeled as kind=species because the source explicitly uses Custom Lineage instead of choosing a race at 1st level.
No 2024 background/species conversion was applied; this remains the 2020 legacy option.
Official Tasha errata adds that the character’s race is Custom Lineage for race prerequisites.

items.name: Changing a Skill
items.summary: Com acordo do DM, uma proficiência em skill pode ser substituída por outra skill que a classe oferecia como opção no nível 1; um nível com Ability Score Increase é sugerido como momento conveniente para a troca.

items.name: Changing Your Subclass
items.summary: Com aprovação do DM, um personagem pode trocar para outra subclasse da mesma classe quando normalmente ganharia uma nova feature de subclasse, substituindo as features antigas pelas da nova subclasse adequadas ao nível atual ou inferior.

extractionNotes: Narrative examples of paladin, wizard, and cleric subclass changes were omitted; their shared mechanical permission is captured under suddenChange.

items.name: Artificer
